context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 verified 4 new features: 1) Dashboard has low_stock_products array with product details (id, name, stock, min_stock_alert) and low_stock_count. Sidebar shows badge on 'Barang' menu when count > 0. 2) Price history tracked when product HPP/price changes via PUT /products/{id}. History available at GET /products/{id}/price-history. Products page has clock icon button to view history. 3) Reports page has 4 tabs including new Laba/Rugi (Profit/Loss). GET /reports/profit-loss returns pos_revenue, pos_cogs, partner_revenue, partner_cogs, total_revenue, total_cogs, gross_profit, margin_percent, daily_data array with chart data. 4) POS shift management: POST /shifts/open?opening_balance=X, GET /shifts/current, POST /shifts/close?closing_balance=X&notes=Y, GET /shifts/history. POS shows 'Buka Shift Baru' dialog on load when no shift open, 'Tutup Shift' button when shift active, close dialog shows summary with balance comparison.

price_history.tracking: Automatic logging when cost_price or price changes on product update

shift_management.open_shift: POST /api/shifts/open?opening_balance=X - Creates shift record with user_id, user_name, opened_at, opening_balance, status=open
shift_management.get_current: GET /api/shifts/current - Returns current open shift with real-time total_sales and total_transactions
shift_management.close_shift: POST /api/shifts/close?closing_balance=X&notes=Y - Updates shift with closed_at, closing_balance, total_sales, cash_sales, notes, status=closed
shift_management.history: GET /api/shifts/history - Returns list of closed shifts
shift_management.ui: Dialog 'Buka Shift Baru' on POS load, 'Tutup Shift' button in header, close dialog with summary
